Employer Partnership

Employer infrastructure built after the talent pool is proven.

Employers·New Jersey·Membership

How it works

Talent Pipeline connects NJ construction firms with a defined pool of Rebuild completers: employer-validated, interview-prepared candidates tracked across construction-management-track entry roles. The membership model is built on outcome evidence, not on the promise of it.

How it connects

Rebuild employers participate in cohort capstones and interviews. Talent Pipeline formalizes that participation into a membership infrastructure: a defined channel connecting construction firms with a recurring pool of screened, employer-validated candidates.

A membership model connecting construction firms with prepared, interview-ready emerging talent.

Aedifica Talent Pipeline is an employer membership infrastructure designed to connect NJ construction firms, GCs, and specialty contractors with a recurring pool of Rebuild completers who have been employer-validated, interview-prepared, and outcome-tracked.

Employer value

  • Access to a defined pool of prepared, interview-ready completers from each Rebuild cohort
  • Validated role relevance: candidates prepared for construction-management-track entry
  • Reduced friction in recruiting for field office, project administration, and support roles
  • Membership infrastructure aligned to NJ construction workforce development needs
